import re

def slugify(s):
    # Convert to lowercase
    s = s.lower()
    # Replace underscores with hyphens
    s = s.replace('_', '-')
    # Replace spaces with hyphens
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', '-', s)
    # Remove punctuation (but keep hyphens)
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9-]', '', s)
    # Remove consecutive hyphens
    s = re.sub(r'-+', '-', s)
    # Trim leading and trailing hyphens
    s = s.strip('-')
    return s
